title: af/self-check@3
description: The cached release check, `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/af/self/latest.toml`, written as TOML; this schema is its shape as a JSON value (ADR-0154). Written only under the check lock `latest.lock`, whose holder stamps `started_at_epoch` into the lock file so a later status can say since when a check has held it. `checked_at_epoch` is when a check last answered (the release source listed its releases); `attempted_at_epoch` when one was last attempted, answered or not, from which `check_every` counts; `last_error` why the last attempt failed, absent once one succeeds. `latest` is the newest release on the configured `channel`; `latest_prerelease` the newest pre-release, asked for whatever the channel while the running af is a pre-release or the channel is `rc`. `auto_updated` is the activation a background check made under `auto_update = "always"`, for its one notice, bound to the default it left. Version 3 adds `attempted_at_epoch`, `last_error` and `latest_prerelease` to version 2; a cache of an earlier version is not read, and a machine with one is due a check (ADR-0145).

epoch.description: Seconds since the Unix epoch; 0 for never.

version.description: A semantic version without the leading v.
